$description: Every (role, platform, file) consumer identity the motion contract carries, one per line, sorted. check:motion-tokens holds tokens/contracts/motion.json to this list in both directions: a consumer that disappears from the contract fails here, and so does one that appears without being registered. The contract alone cannot catch a disappearance - it validates the consumers it finds, never the ones that should be there - so a merge resolution that drops a platform, or retypes its platform or file, passes every other gate with nothing red. Edit this file by hand, never from a generator: the point is that adding or removing a consumer is a deliberate second edit and a reviewable diff, which regenerating from the contract would hide. The failure message prints the exact line to add or delete.
